captions.title: Listings, then New listing
captions.line: Every property lives here, drafts included.

captions.title: Name it first
captions.line: This title becomes the web address when you publish.

captions.title: Write it like an advert
captions.line: The tagline shows on every card. The description sells the viewing.

captions.title: Sale or rent, then the price
captions.line: Pick the type and set the asking price in naira.

captions.title: Where it is
captions.line: City, area and street address. Buyers search by all three.

captions.title: Rooms and amenities
captions.line: Tap a suggestion, or type your own and press Enter.

captions.title: Photos from the library
captions.line: The first one leads the listing card and the gallery.

captions.title: Save your changes
captions.line: Nothing is public while it is a draft.

captions.title: Publish
captions.line: It goes live with a permanent web address.

captions.title: Live on the site
captions.line: Exactly what you wrote, with your photos and your price.

captions.title: Rent works the same way
captions.line: Choose Rent and set the period: per night, month or year.
